reuse.why: Every action still goes through the existing shouldBudgetCategory and averageToBudgetAmount, but the #fixed check is an ad hoc SQL LIKE rather than the tree's extractTagsFromText, and no shared category query is introduced.

duplication.why: The same category SELECT with has_template/group_fixed derivations and the notes join is pasted into setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg (plus a variant in getBudgetData), with the same inline row type each time.

placement.why: The hidden/income policy lives in month-budget-categories.ts, but the template and #fixed rules are actually decided in SQL expressions at each action, so half of the policy sits outside the shared module.

scope.why: Confined to the month-wide actions, the shared policy, registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Changing what counts as #fixed or as having a template means editing six queries; the action parameter of shouldBudgetCategory is now unused after its zero branch was removed.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Template and #fixed exclusions are computed as has_template/group_fixed in each action's SQL in budget/actions.ts instead of inside shouldBudgetCategory (month-budget-categories.ts).

disguised_duplication.where: The category query is copied verbatim (only whitespace differs), not reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: shouldBudgetCategory gains includeHiddenCategories and loses use of its action parameter; the six category queries in budget/actions.ts (getBudgetData, setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3/6/12MonthAvg) each compute the template and #fixed flags themselves.
